_doc: Read by scripts/check-sycl-alloc-zone-contract.py (clauses e, j and q; later clauses add entries). Permanent exemptions only, each with a reason. An entry names its subject (file and function, or a node key), the raw `name` where the code is E-RAW or E-LIBC, and an exact `count`; it fails if it matches nothing or covers a different number, and `name` pins the allocator so a swapped-in different call does not ride the exemption. Hand-edited; see README.md.

entries.name: mmap
entries.reason: cache bookkeeping, guard-page debug mode, no tensor/KV/scratch/pinned/USM bytes: cache_guard_allocator backs the cache's own hash maps when the guard env is set and falls back to std::allocator; the cache cannot allocate its own map nodes through itself. Permanent; canonical contract section 9.1 (the cache_guard_allocator row)

kv_region_release is noexcept and runs from the plan guard's destructor (the registry release proc): its two catch-all handlers release the replan token and report through kv_region_abort, a named abort, because a release that cannot finish must not propagate out of a destructor. A rethrow of ggml_sycl_fallback_error there would std::terminate without the named message, and the try bodies (registry take, slot-state take_retentions, the retain callback) never raise a planned refusal. Permanent; design docs/design/sycl-kv-region-segregation.md, the registry release proc and the noexcept destructor.
